'''Saban 1 (February 16)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>'''
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Faile]], [[Morgase|Maighdin]], and [[Alliandre]] are made into personal ''[[gai'shain]]'' to [[Sevanna]]. [[Therava]] orders them to spy on Sevanna and [[Galina]] forces Faile to agree to steal Therava's [[Oath Rod]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Perrin]] prepares to move his forces in pursuit of the [[Shaido]].
*[[1000 NE]] - The ''[[damane]]'' [[Alivia]] allows herself to be released from her ''[[a'dam]]''.
*[[1000 NE]] - A fake assassination attempt on [[Elayne]] is seemingly foiled by [[Daved Hanlon|Dollin Mellar]]. Mellar is appointed as Captain of the Queen's Guard.
*[[1000 NE]] - Elayne, [[Nynaeve]], and [[Egwene]] discover [[Slayer]] watching them in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.
*[[1000 NE]] - The last of the [[Aes Sedai]] captured at [[Battle of Dumai's Wells|Dumai's Wells]] swear fealty to [[Rand]].
*[[1000 NE]] - The ''damane'' [[Lidya]] fortells [[Tuon]]'s future.
